referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The top includes a small logo and contact line above a dense violet navigation rail. A darkened care photograph carries a centered specialized-care promise and two immediate contact actions. A wide credential banner separates the opening from several alternating image-and-copy chapters. The longer middle section organizes expertise as repeated icon-led rows, followed by a boxed service catalog. An editorial care image and short relationship statement bridge toward a recognition panel, consultation close, newsletter form, and compact footer. Mobile compresses the navigation, places the image and opening copy in a narrow vertical composition, and stacks the expertise, service, and recognition content. The site is clinically positioned and highly information dense. For another provider, preserve only the hierarchy between the promise, explanation, service choices, proof, and contact. Never transfer source-specific credentials, clinical language, results, people, images, or claims.

acceptanceChecks: The first view states the verified care scope and shows a clear consultation action without hiding it in navigation.
Care education, service choice, proof, and contact are separate chapters with readable text density.
The mobile page remains readable at 390 pixels and does not reduce the service catalog to tiny text or horizontal overflow.
Clinical terms, credentials, accreditation, outcomes, response time, service areas, and testimonials come only from verified client facts.
No original source identity, logos, photos, marks, or exact language is used in the generated site.
